_instructions: This file controls bot behavior and your professional preferences. Customize everything here.

tone.coverLetter: warm, confident, storytelling, humanized — NOT robotic or generic
tone.recruiterMessage: personable, direct, respectful of their time, compelling

connectionMessage.style: brief and human — 2-3 sentences max (LinkedIn note limit is 300 chars)

recruiterMessageTemplate.openWith: specific compliment or observation about their company / role
recruiterMessageTemplate.closeWith: low-friction CTA — ask for a quick call or their thoughts, not 'please review my resume'
